page_title: BOU 1-2 IPS | Bournemouth v Ipswich 02/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Jaden Philogene (Ipswich) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+5' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benjamin Johnson departs the field of play to be replaced by Jaden Philogene (Ipswich).
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
87' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Ilya Zabarnyi and he is replaced by Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth).
83' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
82' Substitution. Samy Morsy makes way for Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich).
81' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) will take a corner kick.
78' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
73' Conor Townsend (Ipswich) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
72' Kieran McKenna decides to make a substitution. Julio Enciso will be replaced by Jack Clarke (Ipswich).
72' Here is a change. Nathan Broadhead is going off and Kieran McKenna gives the last tactical orders to Jack Taylor (Ipswich).
72' Today's match ends for Liam Delap who will be replaced by George Hirst (Ipswich).
72' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
72' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) takes the corner.
71' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
67' 1 - 2 Goal 1:2! Evanilson (Bournemouth) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
67' A corner kick by Ipswich is thwarted by the well prepared Kepa Arrizabalaga (Bournemouth).
65' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Alex Palmer.
64' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Robert Jones changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
64' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Bournemouth as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
63' Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Bournemouth.
60' 0 - 2 Goal! Conor Townsend tees up Liam Delap (Ipswich) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the right side of the goal. 0:2.
58' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) replaces Ryan Christie.
58' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alex Scott as he is replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
56' Bournemouth failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

50' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
48' Bournemouth take a short corner kick.
47' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Alex Palmer. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Andoni Iraola probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Adam Smith (Bournemouth). He is replaced by Tyler Adams.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Robert Jones has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
42' That was close by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
41' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Jones has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
34' 0 - 1 Julio Enciso provides Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
33' Bournemouth fail to score from a corner as Alex Palmer (Ipswich) leaps to collect the ball.

33' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Alex Palmer!
29' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
29' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
27' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

26' A pass lands at the feet of Evanilson (Bournemouth) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bournemouth.
25' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
23' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
23' A cross by Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
22' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
19' Conor Townsend (Ipswich) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
17' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
16' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
15' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

14' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bournemouth.
14' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) commits a rough foul. Robert Jones stops the game and makes a call. Bournemouth will take a free kick near the side line.
11' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
11' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner with a short pass.
10' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) sends a long ball in, but Alex Palmer comfortably gathers the ball.
7' The ball is cleared after Alex Scott (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
7' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) sends a long ball in, but Alex Palmer comfortably gathers the ball.
5' Evanilson (Bournemouth) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
4' The Bournemouth players are exchanging some short passes.
2' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Ipswich will have the kick-off.
